tools.name: motion_get_my_user
tools.description: Get the owner of the API key: id, name and email. Good first call to confirm which Motion account is connected. Motion API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: motion_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this user belongs to, with their statuses and labels. Use the workspace ids in the other tools. Motion API: GET /v1/workspaces.

tools.name: motion_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in a workspace, with status and custom field values. Motion API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: motion_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, filtered by workspace, project, assignee, label or name. Completed tasks are left out unless includeAllStatuses is true. Motion API: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: motion_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id: name, description, due date, duration, status, project, assignee and completion time. Motion API: GET /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: motion_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a workspace. Writes to the Motion account: it adds a new task each time it runs, so call it once per task. Motion API: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: motion_get_schedules
tools.description: Get the working schedules of this user: the weekly hours and timezone for each schedule. Motion API: GET /v1/schedules.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: motion_get_my_user · Private data: motion_get_my_user · Public sink: motion_get_my_user, motion_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: motion_get_my_user · Private data: motion_get_my_user · Public sink: motion_get_my_user, motion_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
